in_marathi.name: Hasmat
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Smile, Joy, Delight
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hasmat हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Hasmat is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'has' meaning 'smile' or 'joy' and 'mat' meaning 'that which is stable'. This name is believed to bring happiness and joy to the bearer. It is a name for a boy who is expected to bring delight and joy to those around him.
